component.name: Nullgate
component.summary: Connect your own devices into a private peer-to-peer network

description.p: Nullgate links your computers and phones into a small private network, so you can reach one machine directly with remote desktop, SSH or file sharing instead of routing everything through a home VPN.
There are no accounts and no central server. New devices join with a ticket and a matching emoji code, and connections go directly between devices whenever the network allows it.
